intent.raw: Apply the approved refresh to backend type-test-engine completeness using the new YAML meta-type files, node JSON, independent edge JSON, and two read-only consumer proofs.
intent.objective: Route one-SWU-at-a-time implementation from a shared YAML criterion kernel through exact 13-kind and 16-signature causal evidence, a core receipt, independently produced IOLM and Body War receipts, consumer validation, and terminal independent replay.
intent.operator_sentence: Apply the approved refresh only; do not execute implementation or change release state.

technique_overlays.trigger: The plan spans contract, corpus, independent denominator, generated execution, mutation, and release evidence.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Each selected SWU returns a receipt before its dependent unit is eligible; no whole wave is executed as one task.

technique_overlays.trigger: The engine under test must not define its own expected obligation set or promote its evidence into release authority.
technique_overlays.validation_expectation: Profile admission, YAML authority, independent O_spec, generated O_gen, execution receipts, and release state remain separately owned.

subagent_strategy.trigger: The next eligible implementation is one bounded minted-node adapter SWU with deterministic local checks.
subagent_strategy.explanation: Use one local Task Session per SWU. Any delegated or parallel execution requires a separate DomainSpec subagent strategy and user confirmation.
context: SWU-BTE-003 is the narrowest next unit after the completed SWU-BTE-001 kernel receipt.
SWU-BTE-002 remains W1-exit gated; SWU-BTE-004 through SWU-BTE-010 remain predecessor and Task Session gated.
subagent_strategy.permission_prompt: No subagent execution is authorized by this planning dispatch.

steps.name: Verify the accepted FPR-02B supported-profile decision
stop_conditions: Accepted decision is missing or no longer PASS
Production or implementation authorization is incorrectly set true
UI lane is treated as a dependency

steps.name: Build strict context for one eligible SWU
stop_conditions: More than one SWU is selected
Any acceptance obligation lacks exact source evidence
Write scope or validation surface is missing
SWU-BTE-008 is selected before SWU-BTE-009 and SWU-BTE-004 through SWU-BTE-007 are complete
SWU-BTE-010 is selected before a green verify:bte:core receipt and fresh independently produced IOLM and Body War receipt handles exist

steps.name: Execute one selected SWU
stop_conditions: Write outside the selected SWU scope
A second YAML parser or criterion evaluator is introduced
The engine writes its own independent O_spec denominator
SWU-BTE-008 executes before edge-coverage SWU-BTE-009 is complete
SWU-BTE-008 executes, authors, or validates IOLM or Body War consumer evidence
SWU-BTE-010 executes before verify:bte:core and both fresh external consumer receipts exist
A fixture, schema, example, stale receipt, or BTE-authored receipt substitutes for an independently produced consumer run
A backend formation result is promoted to release authority
Validation fails

steps.name: Independently verify completed proof layers

inputs.ref: future independently produced IOLM consumer receipt
future independently produced Body War consumer receipt
future SWU-BTE-010 verify:bte:consumers and terminal manifest receipt

outputs.ref: future independent core receipt replay result
future independent external-consumer receipt replay result
future independent terminal manifest replay result

stop_conditions: Core, IOLM, Body War, consumer-manifest, or terminal receipt identities are collapsed or indistinguishable
Exact sets or digests differ
Evidence is missing or empty
Any test is skipped, todo, orphaned, or undiscovered
Any targeted mutant survives

steps.name: Synchronize Invoke state from receipts
stop_conditions: Receipt does not prove the selected done criteria
Plan status would exceed evidence
A new blocker has no owner

gates.condition: A strict context pack names the successor profile ID/version, exact 13-kind and 16-signature sets, edge roots, consumer handoffs, write scope, and preserved non-goals.
EXECUTION-DISPATCH.json validates with zero blocks before runtime use.
Exactly one eligible SWU has strict source evidence, write scope, done criteria, and validation coverage.

gates.owner: DomainSpec v2 contract and release owners
gates.condition: YAML schemas, profile admission, generated evidence, independent verification, and release state remain separate authorities.
Frozen O_spec is digest-bound and independently owned before the engine derives O_gen.
Evidence claims only the conservative exact backend profile plus integrated read-only consumer proof for the candidate profile/version.
FPR-02U progress, blockage, or completion is neither an entry gate nor evidence for this FPR-02B package.

gates.owner: BTE validation owner plus independent consumer owners
gates.condition: SWU-BTE-009 closes before SWU-BTE-008; verify:bte:core closes before independently governed IOLM and Body War runs; both fresh external receipt handles exist before SWU-BTE-010; terminal verify:bte composes core and consumer validation.

stop_conditions: Accepted FPR-02B profile decision is missing or contradicted
Any attempt to execute a whole wave rather than one SWU
Any attempt to execute SWU-BTE-008 before SWU-BTE-009 or SWU-BTE-010 before core and both fresh external receipts
Any attempt by the BTE task to run or author IOLM or Body War evidence
Any semantic, UI, cross-feature, or code-conformance scope expansion beyond the accepted 16 backend signatures
Any missing or empty witness, catalogue, test manifest, or receipt
Any release or profile-admission claim produced by technical evidence alone

observability.signal_grouping: Group runtime evidence by dispatch ID, selected SWU ID, profile version, and input digest set.

boundaries.contract: The owner selects the supported profile; implementation may realize only the selected SWU and cannot admit or widen the profile.

boundaries.from_owner: canonical YAML schemas and minted node sources
boundaries.to_owner: derived graph, obligation, test, mutation, and receipt namespaces
boundaries.contract: Generated evidence is read-only projection and never overwrites canonical YAML, node sources, or frozen O_spec.
Receipts may update evidenced plan state but cannot change release or admission state without the owning decision.

boundaries.to_owner: independent IOLM and Body War consumer owners, then SWU-BTE-010 validation owner
boundaries.contract: A green verify:bte:core receipt is handed to each external consumer owner; each owner runs and authors its own fresh receipt; SWU-BTE-010 consumes only their handles and cannot create or repair consumer evidence.

authority.lifecycle: invoke plan authors the route; decision-gate resolves owner choices; task-session owns one bounded execution unit
authority.validation: deterministic repository checks plus independent exact-set replay
authority.evidence: run-scoped receipts bound to profile, schema, adapter, corpus, catalogue, and command digests
authority.memory: observability is non-authoritative and grouped by dispatch and SWU
authority.promotion: FPR-02B and release owners only; technical receipts cannot self-promote

state_namespaces.namespace: DomainSpec v2 canonical YAML and profile contracts
state_namespaces.write_policy: only the exact selected SWU scope after owner gates
one JSON file per node plus one JSON file per edge; generated graph, manifest, views, and receipts are read-only
run-scoped generation with frozen O_spec kept outside engine overwrite authority
synchronize only from verified receipts; promotion requires owner decision

promotion_guardrails: All backend types means the exact 13 active backend kinds, not UI candidates or superseded Saga; FPR-02U is independent.
Formation and relationship completeness means exact 16 YAML criteria plus 16 backend signatures; neither is semantic correctness.
A generated all-kind witness is conformance evidence, not canonical product meaning.
A passing technical receipt is not supported-profile admission or release authorization.
